title: BSeriesBook.jl: Julia companion to the book "B-Series: Algebraic Analysis of Numerical Methods"
description: Julia companion to J. C. Butcher, B-Series: Algebraic Analysis of Numerical Methods (Springer Series in Computational Mathematics 55, 2021). Software for teaching and research: rooted trees in the book's standard numbering, B-series, composition, substitution, modified equations, Runge-Kutta methods, and the underlying one-step method of general linear methods. Initial version, work in progress.
